predicted_window: close of drop_date -> close of the next regular session
spot_basis: unadjusted close of the drop day, which is the entry price

costs.basis: Corwin-Schultz two-day high-low estimate, a FLOOR on the real spread and blind to the widening the drop itself causes

history.basis: observed daily closes, drops at or below -17.75% (0.7 of today's), 3-year lookback

event_plausibility.hunter_must_answer: what caused this fall, with a source and a timestamp

sources: yahoo chart v8 daily bars (split and dividend adjusted)

options.forward_move_basis: straddle over the front expiry. No scheduled event, so this is forward vol and not an event-implied move

lean_components.warning: the first two both move with the size of the drop, and minus the size of the drop is the free control. rev_resolve.py reports lean_vs_free_control_rho; near 1.0 means this lean cannot beat the control because it IS the control
